استرسلن (form X)
# اِسْتَرْسَلْنَ (istarsalna) /is.tar.sal.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَرْسَلَ (istarsala)
# اُسْتُرْسِلْنَ (ustursilna) /us.tur.sil.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَرْسَلَ (istarsala)
# اِسْتَرْسِلْنَ (istarsilna) /is.tar.sil.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَرْسَلَ (istarsala)
